verses.text: Ha in Jeremías in tik ayinto och t'a preso t'a yamak'il b'aj ayek' heb' stanhwumal palacio, ix lolonxi Jehová t'ayin, ix yalani:
Ha in Jehová in in b'onakem yol yib'anhk'inal tik. Wach' wutejnakkan lu'um t'a yet'tal, a in swal t'ayach icha tik:
Awajanh t'ayin, ol in tak'wok t'ayach. Ol in ch'ox t'ayach tas niwak yelk'ochi yet' tas satub'tak yalji to manh ojtakok.

Ha in Jehová he Diosal in, ay wal jun in lolonel swalkan t'a yib'anh spat heb' aj Jerusalén yet' t'a yib'anh spalacio heb' winh sreyal Judá. Ha juntzanh pat chi' wan sjuchajemi yik sk'anchaj sk'enal t'a juntzanh olan t'a smuroal chonhab', yik wach' max och heb' caldeo yak' owal yet'ok.

Ha t'a yol juntzanh pat chi', toxonhej ol b'ut'jokel yuj sniwanil heb' anima ol miljokcham yuj heb' caldeo yuj yowal in k'ol te ay smay. Ol in b'at mikan t'a jun chonhab' tik, yujto te niwan smul heb' ix och t'ayin.
Palta ol wanhtej heb', ol wak'anxi sk'inal heb', ol wak'an kajnaj heb' t'a junk'olal, manhxa tas ol ik'an heb'.
Ol wik'xi meltzaj heb' aj Judá yet' heb' aj Israel b'aj ik'b'ilb'at t'a ch'ok chonhab'il. Ol laj in b'oanxik'e schonhab' heb' icha t'a sb'ab'elal.
Ol wik'el schukal heb' ix yak'och t'ayin. Ol wak'an niwank'olal smul heb' yet' spitalil t'ayin.

Ol te tzalajb'ok in k'ol yuj Jerusalén tik. Ha wal yik ol yab'an masanil nación yuj tas niwan yelk'och ol in k'ulej t'a in chonhab' tik, ol yal wach' lolonel heb' t'ayin, ol in yak'an b'inaj heb'. Palta ol sat wal sk'ol heb', ol ib'xokk'e heb' yuj xiwelal ayik ol yilan heb' jantak wach'il yet' junk'olal ol wak' t'a in chonhab' tik.

Ha ex tik tzeyala' to a jun lum tik kuseltak yajkani, manhxa anima, ma nok' nok' tz'ilchaj t'ay. Wach'chom icha chi' yajkani, ha t'a yoltak scalleal Jerusalén, t'a juntzanh chonhab' t'a Judá tzinan yajkani, b'aj manhxa junok anima, ma junok nok' nok' ayek' t'ay, hata' ol ab'chajxok yoch b'it yik k'inh, b'it yik tzalajk'olal, sb'it heb' kelemtak yet' heb' ix kob'estak ayik snupnaj heb'. Ol ik'chajkot ofrenda yik ak'oj yuj diosal t'a in templo, ol ab'chaj yalji icha tik: Kalek wach' lolonel t'a Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil, yujto te wach', xajan onh yuj t'a masanil k 'inal, xcham heb'. Ha in Jehová in swala' to ol wik'xichaanh jun chonhab' tik icha t'a sb'ab'elal, xchi Jehová.

Ha Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil tz'alan icha tik: Ha t'a jun lum kannak tzinan tik, manhxa anima, manhxa nok' nok' ay t'ay, palta ha t'a spatik yichanh juntzanh chonhab' tik, manh jantakok ol ajxok anh ank'ultak b'aj ol tanhwajxok nok' kalnel yuj heb' stanhwumal.

Ha t'a juntzanh chonhab' t'a tzalkixtak, t'a lum ak'liktak, t'a lum Neguev, t'a lum yik Benjamín, t'a juntzanh ay t'a spatik yichanh Jerusalén yet' pax t'a juntzanhxo chonhab' t'a yol yik Judá, ol iljokxi heb' tanhwum kalnel, ol ab'chaj sb'isan nok' skalnel heb' chi'.
Ol k'och sk'ual, ol elk'och b'aj ix wak' in ti' wak'an in wach'k'olal t'a chonhab' Israel yet' t'a Judá.
Ayik ol jawok jun tiempo chi', ol wak'och jun yinhtilal winhaj David reyal. Ha ol ik'anchaanh tojolal yet' wach'ilal t'a jun nación tik.
Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', a heb' aj Judá ol kolchajkanel heb', haxo heb' aj Jerusalén, manhxa tas ol ik'an heb'. Ha jun b'i tik ol ak'jok t'a heb': “A Jehová tzonh ak'anoch wach'il”, xchama.
Ha in Jehová in swala': Malaj b'ak'inh ol satel yinhtilal winhaj David, ol ochnhej heb' reyal t'a Israel.

Hanhejtona' malaj b'ak'inh ol satpaxel heb' sacerdote yinhtilal Leví, ol snhusnhej silab' heb' t'ayin. T'a junjun k'u ol snhusan ixim trigo heb' silab'il yet' juntzanhxo silab' ol yak' heb' t'ayin, xchi Jehová.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik:
Ha in Jehová in tik swala' to ay jun in trato wak'nakkani to ay k'ualil yet' t'ak'walil t'a stiempoal. Max yal-laj sk'exmaj jun in trato chi'.

Hanhejtona' max yal-laj satel in trato wak'nak yet' winh in chekab' aj David to tz'ochnhej heb' yinhtilal winh reyal t'a sdespacho. Manh ol satelpax in trato in b'onak yet' heb' yinhtilal Leví yik tzin yak'an serwil heb' t'a sacerdoteal.

Ha heb' yinhtilal winh in chekab' aj David chi' yet' heb' yinhtilal Leví tzin ak'an serwil, ol wak' k'ib' sb'isul heb' icha k'een k'anal, ma icha k'een yarenail sti' ha' mar malaj mach syal sb'isani, xchi Jehová.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik:

¿Tom max nachajel uuj tas syal heb' anima, syal heb' to ix in patikejel cha makan inhtilal sik'b'ilel wuuj, haton Israel yet' Judá? Yuj chi' manhxa yelk'och heb' in chonhab' chi' t'a heb', manhxo naciónoklaj yaj t'a yol sat heb'.
Ha in Jehová in in b'onak jun in trato yet' k'ualil yet' t'ak'walil. Swalani chajtil tz'aj sb'ey satcha'anh yet' sat lum tik, max k'exmajlaj.

Hanhejtona' malaj pax b'ak'inh ol k'exmaj in trato yet' heb' yinhtilal Jacob yet' pax heb' yik winh in chekab' aj David. Yowalil ol in sik'elta junok yinhtilal winh, ol yak'an reyal t'a yib'anh heb' yinhtilal Abraham, Isaac yet' Jacob. Ol wik'xichaanh heb', yujto te ay wok'elk'olal t'a heb', xchi Jehová.
